# PRE-GEN

> PRE-GEN is an open standard by Valerii Egorov (Apache-2.0) for asking permission before an AI system generates a real person, brand, voice or work. A registry answers with an Ed25519-signed decision that anyone can verify later. It is not owned by any registry.

- A provider asks `POST /v1/verify/` before generating and gets a `disposition`: `allow` (a licence covers it), `not_blocked` (personal use, nothing granted), `review` (wait for the rights holder) or `deny` (a `PG_*` reason code says why).
- After an `allow`, the provider files a receipt. A decision proves what the registry answered to a declared request, not that the output matched it or that a use is lawful.
- PRE-GEN does not stop systems that never ask. It is authorization, not provenance; it complements C2PA.
- Never send prompt text: send `prompt_hash` (SHA-256 hex). Keep provider secrets server-side.

## Docs

- [Protocol overview](https://www.pregen.org/docs): crypto invariant, signed objects, flow
- [PG codes](https://www.pregen.org/docs/pg-code): identifier format and check character
- [Refusal codes](https://www.pregen.org/docs/refusal-codes): every reason code, hard or soft
- [Integrate](https://www.pregen.org/docs/sdk): HTTP requests, TypeScript SDK, sandbox subjects
- [Versioning](https://www.pregen.org/docs/versions) and [C2PA](https://www.pregen.org/docs/c2pa)

## Registries

- [Registries](https://www.pregen.org/registries) and [registries.json](https://www.pregen.org/registries.json): who runs PRE-GEN. Today one registry is in production: PRAMPTA (https://prampta.com, API https://api2.prampta.com). Issuer prefixes are specified; wider discovery is proposed.
- PG codes: bare `PG-000042*` codes belong to the origin registry; other registries use a four-letter prefix, `PG-NWRD-000042=` (PG codes §8). The prefix is the only part of a code software may read — to find the registry.
- [Specification source](https://github.com/Pastheroza/PRE-GEN-site/tree/main/spec): Markdown spec, test vectors, conformance runner
- [Look up a PG code](https://www.pregen.org/lookup)
